summary.headline: Trump scraps AI testing order; Self-Destruction rises
summary.body: Washington stepped back from AI oversight. President Trump cancelled the signing of an executive order that would have set up voluntary 90-day government testing of frontier models before release, after lobbying from David Sacks, Elon Musk and Mark Zuckerberg. That weakens both Global Coordination and Alignment & Control, which pulls down Gatekeeper (a world that caps AI by cooperating) and lifts Self-Destruction. The Pentagon also added Shield AI's autonomous piloting to the LUCAS attack drone, raising Catastrophic Risk and AI Autonomy, which pushed Self-Destruction and Conquerors up further. Intuit said it will cut about 8% of staff as it shifts to AI agents, a small hit to Shared Prosperity that trims Egalitarian Utopia. Horizon Balance fell 0.71 to 0.4.
summary.movers_note: Self-Destruction +1.0, from the scrapped testing order (+0.47) and the autonomous attack drone (+0.55); Gatekeeper -0.6, almost all from the scrapped order (-0.68); Conquerors +0.6, helped by the drone news (+0.27).

events.title: Trump scraps AI security executive order hours before signing
events.summary: Trump cancelled the signing of an order creating voluntary 90-day pre-release government testing of frontier models after lobbying by Sacks, Musk and Zuckerberg, saying regulation could slow the US lead over China.
events.reason: Head of state rejects pre-release oversight on explicit race-with-China grounds.

events.title: Pentagon adds Shield AI autonomy to LUCAS loitering munition
events.summary: The Pentagon partnered with Shield AI to integrate Hivemind autonomous piloting into the low-cost LUCAS one-way attack drone.
events.reason: Major military AI contract putting autonomy into a strike weapon.

events.title: Intuit cuts ~3,000 jobs as it shifts to AI agents
events.summary: Intuit said it would cut about 8% of staff as it pivots to AI agents, projecting $500M+ annual savings.
events.reason: Company-cited AI-linked layoffs, mid-size. Exact announcement date unclear (reported week of May 18-22).
